title: Frequently asked questions
description: Quick answers for the project's people

questions.question: How do I join a project?
questions.answer: With the invitation that reaches you by email, from an admin or from someone in your family. If you have no account, you choose a password. If you have one, you sign in and accept. Pending invitations are also listed in Your projects. You can also look for one in Find a project, if its admins show it.

questions.question: Who sees my family's ranking?
questions.answer: Only your family. The other families never see it, neither before nor after the lottery.

questions.question: Do I have to rank every unit?
questions.answer: No. Move the ones you care about. The rest keep a place of their own at the end of your ranking.

questions.question: Can two of us change the ranking?
questions.answer: Yes. It is one ranking for the whole family, and any member can change it until the lottery runs. The last change counts.

questions.question: How does the lottery decide?
questions.answer: It first takes care of the family that would be worst off, and gives it the best it can. Then it looks for the greatest satisfaction of the whole project. Only ties are settled at random.

questions.question: Can the result change?
questions.answer: It is final. Only in exceptional cases can an admin invalidate a lottery. Then everyone sees who did it, when and why, and it runs again.

questions.question: Where is the chat?
questions.answer: On a computer or a tablet, in the round button at the bottom right corner: it opens the window over any page. On the phone, in Messages, in the menu. Outside a project, the chat is the Assistant alone.

questions.question: Who reads my messages?
questions.answer: Only those in the conversation. Neither the admins nor the platform's team read a chat they are not in. A message of yours can be edited or deleted for an hour.

questions.question: What goes in the forum, and what in the chat?
questions.answer: The forum is for what concerns the whole project: anyone reads and replies, and a new topic is announced to everyone. The chat is for one person or a group.

questions.question: What is the Assistant?
questions.answer: An automatic helper for questions about the app: the first conversation in your messages. It explains how something works and takes you there. It knows nothing about other people, can be wrong, and has a limit of questions a day.

questions.question: Who sees the files I share?
questions.answer: Everyone in the project, and nobody outside. You can edit the description or remove what you shared; admins can remove it too.

questions.question: I changed my email and nothing happened.
questions.answer: We sent a confirmation link to the new address. Your account keeps the old one until you open it.
